Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min intro — please pick 2 options and nominate a tech lead

Hi Elena / Felix — great to speak today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the 30‑minute intro/demo: 

Recap (2 minutes):
- You’re evaluating inference platforms for demo/proof-of-concept around latency-sensitive chat and embeddings at scale.
- Top priorities: predictable latency for p95 < 250ms, VPC/private deployment options, and cost transparency for high-traffic endpoints.

Next steps (ask):
1) Please pick 2 of the time options below that work for the wider team (we’ll invite a solutions engineer + a product owner).
   - Option A: Wed, Nov 25 — 10:00–10:30 PT
   - Option B: Thu, Nov 26 — 15:00–15:30 PT
   - Option C: Mon, Nov 30 — 09:00–09:30 PT
2) Could you confirm the technical liaison who should join the deep-dive (infra/ops contact)?
3) Any immediate blockers we should know about (SSO/SCIM, EKS restrictions, procurement timelines)?

I attached a one‑page mutual action plan and a short post‑discovery notes file to help prep. If none of the options fit, drop a couple preferred windows and we’ll propose alternatives.

Calendar quick-pick: https://cal.example.com/neha/suggested-slots
Prep doc: https://drive.example.com/file/d/1A2b3MutualActionPlan

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0184
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-min intro — please pick 2 options and nominate a tech lead

Neha — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Quick answers: 

- We can do Option B (Thu, Nov 26 — 15:00 PT) and Option C (Mon, Nov 30 — 09:00 PT). Option B is preferred.
- Tech liaison will be Felix (felix@solve.ai) — he handles infra and SRE for our inference stack.
- Potential blockers: we use Okta SSO (SCIM provisioning planned), and procurement needs an initial SOW for approval; procurement is okay to move fast once dates are locked.

A couple of follow-ups for the demo:
- Can the demo include a brief run-through of private/VPC deployment options and a short perf snapshot for a 1M-token/day throughput scenario?
- Also appreciate any notes on expected lead time for Dedicated capacity if we choose reserved capacity.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the invite.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of ML Platforms | SolveAI
elena.ruiz@solveai.com
